card.name: Shake-before-use directions
card.fires_on: Punctuation or spaces in DIRECTIONS lines about shaking a bottle before use, right before the adult and children dosing. Also fires on the gap before a number of minutes in bottle-handling steps.

modes.label: Shake instruction
modes.description: The period or space after 'Shake' or 'before use' in a DIRECTIONS line.
modes.example: DIRECTIONS: Shake 10 times before use<<.>> Adults & children over 12 years

modes.label: Wait or drops step
modes.description: A space or word in other bottle-handling steps, such as waiting minutes or adding drops.
